description: The inventory lists projects valued at five million dollars or more that were recently completed, are under construction, or are proposed to start within two years. The source warns that confidentiality and missing information prevent full coverage even above the threshold. CSV, spreadsheet, XML and JSON distributions are listed. Package start and end fields both say 1980; these do not establish the inventory observation date and are retained as unresolved metadata. The description does not establish current project status or distinguish every sector in the returned inventory. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue supplies the original Alberta identifiers and distribution descriptions. The source names Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs and present file access remain unverified. This record covers inspected descriptive metadata; no dataset, document, archive or linked resource body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are unstated unless described above. Unlisted fields and numerical values remain unknown.
